title: New Chess Game
next_chapter_hook: Ling Yuan's meaningful gaze fell upon Chen Ji, his aged voice echoing through the night wind: "Chen Ji, would you follow this old man back to the Sect Gate for a discussion?"

text.content: That wisp of black energy writhed like a living creature, bearing the desolate intent of ten thousand years' decay as it climbed the stone tablet. Mo Xiansheng's voice exploded in Chen Ji's Mental Sea: "Remnant soul rampage! Not something you can contend with, retreat quickly!" Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly, the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve warming faintly—he had already foreseen three breaths later—the black energy would transform into man-devouring hands, dragging everyone present into the abyss.

"Go!" Chen Ji hissed, seizing Su Qingyao's wrist as she still studied the inscriptions on the stone tablet, casting a glance at Ye Qing. Understanding his intent, Ye Qing's demonic path mist instantly spread, enveloping all four of them. Su Qingyao stumbled from the pull, about to protest, when she saw the black energy had already transformed into countless tentacles, lunging toward the spot where they had stood moments before—had they been a heartbeat slower—cold sweat broke out on her back.

dialogue.content: "That thing..." Su Qingyao's voice trembled slightly, "is exactly as recorded in the archives about ancient malevolent beings. How did you know to retreat?" Chen Ji released her wrist, his expression calm: "Good luck." Su Qingyao stared at him for three breaths before finally冷哼一声, not pursuing the matter—she knew this废物 wouldn't speak truth.

Ye Qing rode the escape light, her voice drifting from the mist: "Chen Gongzi's instinct for danger is more precise than those old monsters." Her tone carried a hint of playfulness, "I'm becoming more curious—what secrets are you hiding?" Chen Ji stood within the mist, gazing at the receding ruins, a faint smile curving his lips: "Secrets? Just don't want to die."

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, carrying rare gravity: "That remnant soul was an ancient tomb guardian, awakened by the power of the Tianji Record. Though it cannot pursue beyond the ruins, it has already transmitted news of the异变出去." Chen Ji's heart chilled—the emergence of ruins, the awakening of malevolent beings, the possessor of the remnant scroll—these news would spread throughout the cultivation world within three days. The time remaining for him was running out.

choice.prompt: At the fork outside the ruins, mist shrouded everything. Mo Xiansheng warned: "Eyes and ears from various forces already densely cover a hundred li in all directions. If you show yourself, you will be marked; if you take the detour, it will cost three more days." Ye Qing proposed using demonic path mist for cover, while Su Qingyao looked at Chen Ji, awaiting his decision.

choices.description: Openly departing as an Outer Disciple/Servant, letting everyone see a "废物" passing by the ruins, concealing the true harvest.
choices.visible_reward: Reinforcing the废物 persona, making enemies lower their guard
choices.risk_hint: If Someone Tests, May Reveal Flaws

text.content: Chen Ji straightened his worn Servant Disciple robe, completely sealing the aura of the Tianji Record Fragment. "Let's go," he stepped out of the mist, "We're going back to the Sect to receive punishment." Su Qingyao froze: "Receive punishment?" Chen Ji苦笑: "Something happened at the ruins, and my not being present as an Outer Disciple/Servant is already a crime; returning three days late is an even greater offense." This move of his actually gripped the initiative—who would care about a废物 receiving punishment?

dialogue.content: Ye Qing couldn't help but laugh lightly: "Chen Gongzi's move is brilliant. Let everyone see the废物, let everyone forget the treasure." Her demonic path mist dissipated quietly, becoming a thin veil concealing her stunning features, "Interesting, I'm starting to look forward to those big shots' expressions when they realize they were tricked by a废物."

choices.description: Borrowing Ye Qing's demonic path mist for cover, slipping away unnoticed while various forces' eyes are focused on the ruins themselves.
choices.visible_reward: Completely Concealing Position, Leaving Enemies with No Trail
choices.risk_hint: If the Mist is Seen Through by Experts, Will Expose Collusion with the Demonic Path

text.content: Ye Qing's demonic path mist thickened beyond dissolution, completely wrapping the four into nothingness. Chen Ji closed his eyes to sense, the Tianji Record in his sleeve trembling slightly—images of three days later gradually grew clear: various major forces ransacking the ruins, only to find a field of remains and the remnant soul of the malevolent being. "Let them search slowly," Chen Ji said calmly, "The truly valuable things are no longer there."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao frowned within the mist: "Who exactly are you?" Throughout this journey, the Chen Ji she witnessed was calm as an abyss, calculating without exception—nothing like that废物 who wouldn't fight back when bullied. Chen Ji turned to look at her, his gaze profound: "Su Shimei, some things—the more you know, the faster you die." Su Qingyao's heart jolted—within these words lay a genuine warning.

choices.description: Having Ye Qing separate a mist avatar, deliberately appearing in the east to attract attention while the true body quietly leaves from the west.
choices.visible_reward: Let the pursuers run around in circles, while reinforcing Ye Qing's image as the 'Demonic Path Enchantress'
choices.risk_hint: If the doppelganger is exposed, it will backfire

text.content: Ye Qing's eyes brightened at his words: "Interesting." Her fingers formed seals, and a graceful silhouette separated from her main body, darting eastward wrapped in dense demonic energy. "Disciples from various sects love to track demonic energy the most," Chen Ji said coldly. "They chase that doppelganger, which opens the road for us." As expected, several figures soared into the sky, lunging straight for the east. Ye Qing's true body laughed softly: "Brilliant. This is the first time this Saint has played the scapegoat."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stood atop the westward escape light, gazing at the pitiful fog doppelganger being chased in the east, a cold glint flickering in his eyes: "The Demonic Path Saint's notorious reputation grows by the day." Ye Qing drew close, her voice low: "Chen Gongzi, you owe me an explanation—what does that prophecy on the Tianji Record mean?" Chen Ji fell silent for a moment before finally speaking: "In three months, you will know."

text.content: Three days later, at the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate. Chen Ji and his group returned travel-worn and weary, just as the gate-guarding disciple's astonished gaze fell upon them. "Ch-Chen Shixiong?" The disciple gaped, as if seeing a ghost. "How are you still alive? That night when the ruins collapsed, not a single disciple who entered came out..." Chen Ji sighed: "Lucky me—got a stomachache halfway there and turned back." The disciple's expression was a masterpiece—the废物 was indeed a废物—even death couldn't claim him.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao stood nearby, the corner of her lips twitching imperceptibly, yet her vigilance grew stronger—the废物's words contained not a single truth among three. She said coldly: "I'll report the ruins incident to the Elder, and you..." Chen Ji cupped his hands: "This disciple will return to the Servants' Quarters to receive punishment, never delaying Shijie's important matters." Su Qingyao gave him a long, searching look, then without another word, flew straight toward the Council Hall. Ye Qing's silhouette had already vanished into the shadows, leaving behind a transmission before departing: "Be careful of Ling Yuan."

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his Mental Sea, carrying a hint of approval: "Good. Within three days without touching the Heavenly Fate Value, you have learned restraint." Chen Ji responded in his heart: "A three-month death curse—every point of Heavenly Fate Value is my life." He raised his eyes toward the depths of the sect, where clouds and mist shrouded the place—the Sect Master's secluded cultivation grounds—where Ling Yuan dwelled. Mo Xiansheng sighed: "Ling Yuan has emerged from seclusion. Your return today, he must already know. That old fox... will not let any suspicious matters pass."

"Interesting." A smile curved Chen Ji's lips as he strode toward the Servants' Quarters. Along the way, disciples scrambled to avoid him, their gazes filled with mockery and contempt. "The废物 dares return?" "I heard the ruins held great fortune—yet this idiot probably didn't even dare enter." "A废物 is a废物; what's the point of having good luck? Still just mud that won't stick to the wall." Chen Ji heard nothing, his steps neither hurried nor slow, yet in his heart he was calculating rapidly—within three days, news would have spread. How would Ling Yuan make his move?

dialogue.content: "Regarding your sister—Chen Nian's whereabouts," Mo Xiansheng suddenly said, "I have deduced a thread of clues." Chen Ji's steps halted slightly, his gaze turning ice-cold: "Speak." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried solemnity: "The Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds, the Heavenly Fate Lock Key. Her being taken was no coincidence—she was used as... a key to open a certain place." Chen Ji's fists clenched, his knuckles whitening. Chen Nian—his sister, missing for years, the kin he had never stopped searching for. He drew a deep breath, suppressing his emotions: "Once I resolve matters at hand, I will pay the Holy Sect a visit."

choice.prompt: In the Servants' Quarters, Chen Ji gazed at the familiar dilapidated cottage, his expression calm. The three-month death curse countdown had begun, Ling Yuan's shadow loomed overhead, and Chen Nian's clues added fresh worry. At this moment, he had to make a choice—

choices.text: Return to the sect to lie low
choices.description: Use punishment as an excuse to hide in the Servants' Quarters, reduce presence, deprive Ling Yuan of a pretext to act, while secretly gathering intelligence and building connections.
choices.visible_cost: Actions restricted; may miss the initiative
choices.visible_reward: Consolidate the废物 persona, lull enemies into complacency, buy more time for scheming
choices.risk_hint: If Ling Yuan takes the initiative, lying low becomes passive instead

text.content: Chen Ji pushed open the wooden door of the Servants' Quarters; the familiar musty smell assaulted him. He lay down on that worn wooden bed, staring at the ceiling in a daze. "A废物 should act like a废物," he murmured to himself. "If I'm going to hide my talents, I'll hide them completely." He closed his eyes; the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve grew slightly warm. In three months, he needed to weave a great net in the shadows, ensnaring all enemies in one fell swoop.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice arose: "The lying-low strategy is sound, but Ling Yuan will not let you rest peacefully." Chen Ji replied calmly: "I know. So if he makes a move, it will be the timing I've been waiting for." He turned over, a cold smile curling at the corner of his mouth: "Let the storm come more violently." Outside the window, the sun sank westward, stretching his shadow long.

choices.description: Ling Yuan's emergence from seclusion surely hides secrets; use the Tianji Record's foresight to probe the old Sect Master's movements and weaknesses, but it will consume Heavenly Fate Value.
choices.visible_cost: Each foresight consumes 5 points of Heavenly Fate Value—extremely high risk
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial intelligence on Ling Yuan; preemptively devise counter-strategies
choices.risk_hint: Exhausting all Heavenly Fate Value will trigger deadly backlash

text.content: Deep in the night, Chen Ji sat cross-legged; the Tianji Record Fragment flew from his sleeve, hovering before his eyes. He closed his eyes, touching the yellowed page with his divine sense—foresight activated. Three breaths later, he abruptly opened his eyes, cold sweat beading on his forehead. In the vision, Ling Yuan stood at the apex of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion, holding a pitch-black token in his hand, upon which was carved a vertical pupil. "The Eye of Heavenly Mandate..." Chen Ji murmured, his pupils constricting. "This old monster actually has connections to that thing?"

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice turned grave: "The Vertical Pupil Token... that is the fate-mark of each Tianji Record inheritor through generations. Ling Yuan was once a candidate for the Tianji Record, but it chose you and cast him aside." Chen Ji said deeply: "So he hates me to the bone." Mo Xiansheng sighed: "Hate alone? That old fox wants your life, but even more, he wants your legacy." Chen Ji laughed coldly: "So that's how it is—let's see who plays the higher game."

choices.description: Proactively go to the Sect Master's Hall to confess his sins, appearing before Ling Yuan in the most humble posture, letting the old fox see the 'panic' of the 'waste,' shaking his judgment.
choices.visible_cost: May expose weaknesses, inviting more severe suppression
choices.visible_reward: Observe Ling Yuan up close, gather key intelligence, while reinforcing the 'waste' impression
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is extremely scheming, may set a trap

text.content: The next morning, Chen Ji changed into a faded old robe, clutching a pot of cheap wine, trembling as he walked toward the Sect Master's Hall. 'Disciple Chen Ji, specially comes to confess his sins to the Sect Master!' His voice carried a perfectly calibrated tremor, drawing glances from passing Inner Sect disciples. 'Haha, this waste actually came voluntarily?' 'Probably scared out of his mind!' Chen Ji ignored them, a cold smile playing in his heart—Ling Yuan, do you dare to kill me face to face?

dialogue.content: Inside the Sect Master's Hall, sandalwood incense curled through the air. Ling Yuan sat upright at the main seat, his turbid old eyes gazing at Chen Ji kneeling in the hall, silent for a long while. That gaze was like substantial pressure, causing the air to freeze. 'Regarding the ruins,' the aged voice finally spoke, 'you certainly have a resilient life.' Chen Ji remained prostrate, his voice trembling: 'Disciple... disciple is foolish, dares not covet such fortune, only wishes to return to the sect to accept punishment...' Ling Yuan narrowed his eyes, smiling meaningfully: 'Rise. Come forward.'

text.content: At this moment, a disciple's report came from outside the hall: 'Reporting to the Sect Master, Xuanwu Sect's Han Lie Young Hero seeks an audience!' Ling Yuan's brow furrowed slightly, withdrawing his gaze from Chen Ji: 'Let him in.' Chen Ji's heart stirred—Han Lie's arrival was so timely, coincidence or intention? Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out: 'The Xuanwu Sect has long coveted the Tianqing Sect, this ruins incident must have already alerted them. Han Lie's visit here is clearly not his true purpose.'

dialogue.content: The hall doors opened wide, and a figure as straight as a spear strode in. Han Lie's gaze swept over Chen Ji kneeling on the ground, sneering: 'This is that waste? Such a major incident at the ruins, and he actually managed to survive?' He turned to Ling Yuan, clasped his fist: 'Ling Sect Master, my father has important matters to discuss—I hear an ancient supreme treasure emerged from the ruins, has your sect obtained it?' Ling Yuan stroked his beard with a smile: 'Young Hero Han, you jest. The ruins were extremely dangerous, the elite disciples I sent there couldn't even survive...' His gaze meaningfully glanced at Chen Ji, 'But there were some unexpected gains.'

text.content: Chen Ji remained prostrate on the ground, listening to their conversation clearly in his heart—Ling Yuan was speaking to Han Lie. The old fox was implying: the fortune from the ruins fell into the Tianqing Sect's hands, and that 'waste' likely knows something. Han Lie's gaze was indeed drawn to Chen Ji, filled with scrutiny and disdain: 'This waste?' Ling Yuan said calmly: 'Fortune has never asked about one's origins.' The atmosphere in the hall suddenly became tense, Chen Ji felt two pressures landing on him simultaneously—one from Ling Yuan's probing, one from Han Lie's coveting.

Mo Xiansheng's voice urgently rang out in his Mental Sea: 'Ling Yuan is using a borrowed knife! He wants Han Lie to act against you, to test your true depth!' Chen Ji sneered in his heart, but his expression grew even more panicked: 'Spare my life, both seniors! This disciple is just a Servant Disciple, knows nothing!' Han Lie coldly hummed, stepping forward: 'Waste, tell me what you saw in the ruins, otherwise—' His palm raised, the pressure of Nascent Soul realm poured down, Chen Ji was instantly pressed flat to the ground, blood trickling from the corner of his mouth.

choice.prompt: The pressure of Nascent Soul realm crushed down like mountains, Chen Ji bled from his mouth yet still maintained his terrified waste appearance. Ling Yuan sat dignified on the high seat, his gaze profound and deep; Han Lie stood above, his face full of disdain. At this moment he must make a choice—

choices.description: Completely empty his expression, only seeking to preserve his life, letting both Ling Yuan and Han Lie believe the waste is truly just waste, with no value whatsoever.
choices.visible_reward: Let enemies completely lower their guard, while exposing Ling Yuan's sinister intentions
choices.risk_hint: If Han Lie strikes to kill, he may truly die

text.content: Chen Ji lay on the ground, body trembling, tears and mucus covering his face: 'I... I really saw nothing! Please, spare me!' His appearance like this caused the disciples secretly watching outside the hall to burst into laughter. Han Lie's eyes flashed with disgust: 'This kind of trash?' He withdrew his pressure, as if looking at it longer would dirty his eyes. Ling Yuan stroked his beard with a smile: 'Young Hero Han, it seems this waste truly knows nothing.' But a trace of doubt lingered in his heart—could it really be this simple?

dialogue.content: Han Lie coldly snorted: 'Waste of my time!' He flicked his sleeve and turned to leave. Ling Yuan's gaze fell on Chen Ji, saying meaningfully: 'Chen Ji, you may withdraw for now.' Chen Ji scrambled out of the Sect Master's Hall, only after turning a corner did he slowly straighten up. He wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, a cold light flashing in his eyes: 'Han Lie, I remember you.' Mo Xiansheng sighed: 'Your humiliation today will surely be repaid.' Chen Ji coldly laughed: 'No rush, the good show has just begun.'

choices.description: In the instant Han Lie lowers his guard, use the Tianji Record's residual foresight to guide Han Lie's attention toward Ling Yuan, letting the two fight each other.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 3 Heavenly Fate points to guide the situation
choices.visible_reward: Cause Han Lie to develop suspicion toward Ling Yuan, letting the渔翁得利 reap the benefits as they struggle
choices.risk_hint: If discovered, it will be utter destruction

text.content: In the instant Han Lie withdrew his pressure, the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's sleeve slightly vibrated, an intangible fluctuation spreading outward. Han Lie's footsteps paused, suddenly frowning: 'Ling Sect Master, you just said the elite disciples you sent couldn't survive—then how did this waste survive?' Ling Yuan's expression slightly changed: 'Young Hero Han, what do you mean?' Han Lie coldly laughed: 'What I mean is, what exactly did the Tianqing Sect obtain in those ruins, worth killing so many disciples to silence them?' The hall's atmosphere suddenly became tense.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's gaze turned gloomy: 'Young Hero Han, what do you mean by that?' Han Lie said proudly: 'Nothing special, just asking on my father's behalf.' He turned toward Chen Ji, eyes flashing with sharpness, 'Waste, you better think carefully before answering—surviving among so many elite disciples' corpses, was that really just luck?' Chen Ji cowered, his gaze wandering between Ling Yuan and Han Lie—good, the seed of suspicion has been planted.

choices.description: Deliberately speak ambiguously, both hinting that he knows something while displaying the cowardice of a废物, causing Han Lie and Ling Yuan to suspect each other.
choices.visible_cost: Extremely high risk, possibly offending both parties simultaneously
choices.visible_reward: Making both parties take an interest in him, gaining a chance to catch his breath
choices.risk_hint: If he lets slip even a word, he will die without a burial place

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, a dazed glint flickering in his eyes: "Two seniors... I-I seem to have heard something strange..." Han Lie raised an eyebrow: "What sound?" Chen Ji cowered: "It's... someone speaking, saying something about 'Heavenly Secrets cannot be revealed'..." He hastily covered his mouth, as if realizing he'd said something wrong. Ling Yuan's pupils constricted—the words "Heavenly Secrets," this was his deepest obsession. Han Lie keenly noticed Ling Yuan's change in expression, his gaze becoming playful.

dialogue.content: "Interesting," Han Lie withdrew his stepping foot, re-examining Chen Ji, "Sect Master Ling, it seems this废物 really does have some secrets." Ling Yuan's face turned dark: "Young Han, this is an internal matter of Tianqing Sect—" Han Lie interrupted him: "I'm just curious, why would Tianqing Sect's '废物' react to the words 'Heavenly Secrets'?" Chen Ji lay on the ground trembling, but in his heart he was coldly laughing—Han Lie, you fool, you took the bait as expected. Ling Yuan, you want to use someone as a knife? Then don't blame me for digging a pit for you too.

text.content: Just then, commotion erupted outside the hall. "Senior Su? You cannot enter—" "Move aside!" Su Qingyao, dressed in white sword attire, strode boldly into the Sect Master's Hall, her cold gaze sweeping over Han Lie before finally landing on Chen Ji lying on the ground. Her brow furrowed: "Sect Master, Chen Ji is my Inner Disciple. Why does the Young Hero from Xuanwu Sect need to personally interrogate him?" Han Lie raised an eyebrow: "Senior Su is here to protect him?" Su Qingyao coldly snorted: "Protect? I simply won't allow outsiders to humiliate our Tianqing Sect disciples."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji struggled to rise from the ground, wiping the blood from the corner of his mouth, offering Su Qingyao a grateful smile: "Thank you, Senior Su." Su Qingyao didn't even glance at him: "废物, go outside and wait for me." Her tone was ice-cold, yet it warmed Chen Ji's heart—this woman, tough on the outside but soft on the inside, was an ally worth cultivating. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out: "This woman shares destiny with you and will be of great use in the future." Chen Ji silently nodded, stumbling out of the Sect Master's Hall under Su Qingyao's protection. Behind him, the confrontation between Han Lie and Ling Yuan continued.

text.content: Outside the hall, Chen Ji leaned against a pillar, gazing at the setting sun on the horizon, his eyes flickering with brilliance. Today's battle, though humiliating, successfully planted three seeds: Han Lie's suspicion of Ling Yuan, Ling Yuan's wariness of Han Lie, and Su Qingyao's subtle protection. Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of praise: "You, with your废物 body, have maneuvered between two major forces without revealing any flaws. You truly possess the bearing of a great general." A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips: "This is just the beginning." He looked toward the Sect Master's Hall, where Ling Yuan's figure seemed to still be watching him from within the shadows of burning incense. "Three months," he murmured, "will be enough."

Inside the Sect Master's Hall, the atmosphere was tense as a drawn sword. As Han Lie and Ling Yuan's confrontation concluded, the latter said deeply: "If Young Hero Han has no other business, please leave." Han Lie coldly laughed, about to depart, when a disciple rushed over: "Reporting to Sect Master, reporting to Young Hero Han! Outside the mountain gate... there is an elder requesting an audience!" Ling Yuan frowned: "What elder?" The disciple's voice trembled: "He... he said his surname is Ling, with a single character Yuan..." The hall suddenly fell silent. Han Lie猛然turned his head, his gaze死死盯着 Ling Yuan—this old thing dared impersonate his Xuanwu Sect's honored guest? Ling Yuan's face turned iron-green: "Nonsense! This old man is right here!"

dialogue.content: Outside the mountain gate, Chen Ji stood behind Su Qingyao, a faint smile playing at the corner of his mouth. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out: "You used the power of the Tianji Record to implant the illusion in that disciple's heart—Ling Yuan's avatar? Clever." Chen Ji responded in his heart: "The old fox wanted to use Han Lie's hand to probe my底牌, so I'll let him taste the滋味 of being betrayed by his own people." Su Qingyao glanced back at him, a hint of doubt flashing in her eyes—why didn't this废物的 expression look like someone who'd been wronged?

text.content: Inside the Sect Master's Hall, Ling Yuan and Han Lie simultaneously soared into the air, racing toward the mountain gate. Chen Ji watched from afar as two streaks of light crossed the sky, whispering: "Now the good show begins." Indeed, moments later, a furious roar came from the mountain gate direction, followed by intense spiritual energy fluctuations. Han Lie's overbearing voice resounded across the heavens: "Good for you, Ling Yuan! Daring to send someone to impersonate our Xuanwu Sect's Supreme Elder, if you don't give me an explanation today, this won't end peacefully!" Ling Yuan's辩解声 was drowned in the more intense conflict. Chen Ji's smile grew increasingly rich—the first round, he had won.

Su Qingyao frowned, gazing toward the mountain gate: "What's going on?" Chen Ji shook his head, looking completely bewildered: "Disciple doesn't know... perhaps there's some misunderstanding." Su Qingyao deeply looked at him, her gaze carrying a searching quality: "Chen Ji, you were wronged today. Go back and rest." Chen Ji cupped his hands to take his leave, stumbling toward the Servants' Quarters. Behind him, Su Qingyao's voice came: "Your injuries..." Chen Ji didn't look back: "Minor wounds, nothing serious." He walked dozens of zhang before suddenly stopping, gazing toward the distant horizon—where, dark clouds were gathering, as if something major was about to happen.

Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded grave: "When you just now used the Tianji Record's power to create an illusion, though only for a moment, it has already been noticed by certain existences." Chen Ji's heart tightened: "What existence?" Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment: "The Eye of Heavenly Dao." These four words were like a basin of cold water pouring over his head. Chen Ji's footsteps halted. The Eye of Heavenly Dao, that ultimate antagonist, had actually already started paying attention to him? Mo Xiansheng sighed: "Every time you use the Tianji Record, it's like lighting a torch in the darkness. Those lofty existences above will eventually follow the light to find you."

Night wind gradually rose, Chen Ji stood alone under the old locust tree outside the Servants' Quarters, gazing blankly at the starry sky. "So the more I use the Tianji Record, the easier it becomes for the Eye of Heavenly Dao to lock onto me?" Mo Xiansheng said: "Exactly. But this is also unavoidable—if you don't use the Tianji Record, you probably won't survive three months either." Chen Ji coldly laughed: "It seems whether I use it or not, it's a dead end." Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment: "Not necessarily. The more complete the Tianji Record, the more likely it can break free from the Eye of Heavenly Dao's control. What you need now is time."

Just then, a figure quietly landed beside Chen Ji. Ye Qing, wrapped in black纱, her voice low: "The conflict between Ling Yuan and Han Lie has alarmed the sect elders. The two have been temporarily separated. But this matter will not end peacefully." Chen Ji turned to look at her: "Why are you here?" Ye Qing said indifferently: "Just came to see if my 'partner' was scared to death." She paused, "Your performance today was more ruthless than I imagined." Chen Ji smiled without speaking. Ye Qing stepped closer, lowering her voice: "The three-month death calamity—what exactly is your plan?"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji gazed at Ye Qing, her face half-illuminated and half-shadowed by the moonlight, becoming increasingly mysterious. He suddenly remembered Mo Xiansheng's words—Ye Qing's "Demonic Path Mist" could conceal the aura of the Tianji Record, making her an important strategic ally. He pondered for a moment, then spoke: "My plan is very simple—within three months, make Ling Yuan, Han Lie, and everyone else coveting the Tianji Record, all become my chess pieces." Ye Qing raised an eyebrow: "You think big." Chen Ji turned to gaze at the night sky: "If I didn't dare to think, I would have died long ago."

text.content: Ye Qing stared at him for a long while, then suddenly laughed lightly: "Interesting. Chen Ji, I'm increasingly looking forward to whether you can survive these three months." Chen Ji turned to look at her, his eyes carrying a bit of seriousness: "I won't die. Because there are still people I must protect." Ye Qing was slightly stunned, seemingly thinking of something, and stopped asking. She turned and merged into the night, leaving a sentence before departing: "Ling Yuan won't let you off. Be careful." Chen Ji gazed at where she disappeared, a faint smile appearing at the corner of his mouth: "I know."

Deep night, Servants' Quarters. Chen Ji lay on that decrepit wooden bed, staring blankly at the ceiling. Today's events were merely the tip of the iceberg in his chess game. Ling Yuan's ambition, Han Lie's greed, Su Qingyao's suspicion, Ye Qing's observation—everyone was within his calculations, yet completely unaware. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out: "You today used illusions to sow discord between the two, already planting the seeds of disaster. In the days to come, they will surely试探 each other, mutually on guard." Chen Ji closed his eyes, murmuring: "Let them fight. When they're both exhausted and injured, that will be the time for me to close the net." He turned over, a cold smile on his lips, "Three months, will be enough." Outside the window, the moonlight was like water, spilling across his calm features. Yet what he didn't know was that in the heavens above, a pair of invisible eyes, through layers of clouds, was quietly watching him—the Eye of Heavenly Dao, had already awakened.
